title: The Boat as Big as a Village

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After watching a distant speck that may have been a whale, a child wonders about boats as big as villages.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After watching a distant speck on the horizon that may have been a whale, (name1), a child, wonders whether distant people might build boats as big as villages.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Builders sketch a floating village with gardens on its deck; everyone agrees it would need very good builders.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A fisher worries that such a boat would frighten all the fish away.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The children imagine families living on the sea forever, fishing from their own windows.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder wonders whether those people would miss solid ground.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village agrees it was probably a whale and cheers for it anyway.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The speck never returns, and the question stays open.
